title: view size is not compatible with input tensor's size and stride
bug_description:
import torch
x = torch.arange(12)
y = x[::2]  # non-contiguous view
z = y.view(3, 2)  # ❌ fails because y isn’t contiguous



Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "weird_view_error.py", line 4, in <module>
    z = y.view(3, 2)
RuntimeError: view size is not compatible with input tensor's size and stride
(at least one dimension spans across two contiguous subspaces). 
Use .reshape(...) instead.
